{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Drop QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
sales = sales[sales['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Group by channel and customer_segment and compute mean revenue
stratified_avg = completed_orders.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue'].mean().reset_index()

# Pivot to get channel as columns and customer_segment as rows
stratified_pivot = stratified_avg.pivot(index='customer_segment', columns='channel', values='revenue')

# Compute the difference (email - paid_search) for each segment
differences = stratified_pivot['email'] - stratified_pivot['paid_search']

# Print the exact values for evidence
print(f'Average revenue (email, loyal): {stratified_pivot.loc["loyal", "email"]:.2f}')
print(f'Average revenue (paid_search, loyal): {stratified_pivot.loc["loyal", "paid_search"]:.2f}')
print(f'Difference (email - paid_search, loyal): {differences["loyal"]:.2f}')

print(f'Average revenue (email, new): {stratified_pivot.loc["new", "email"]:.2f}')
print(f'Average revenue (paid_search, new): {stratified_pivot.loc["new", "paid_search"]:.2f}')
print(f'Difference (email - paid_search, new): {differences["new"]:.2f}')

print(f'Average revenue (email, returning): {stratified_pivot.loc["returning", "email"]:.2f}')
print(f'Average revenue (paid_search, returning): {stratified_pivot.loc["returning", "paid_search"]:.2f}')
print(f'Difference (email - paid_search, returning): {differences["returning"]:.2f}')"}
